verdict.rationale: Attio's reporting page lists a 'Weighted pipeline' report alongside stage conversion, win rate and sales cycle metrics. Combined with the optional Deal object and live charting, this indicates first-party pipeline-value reporting weighted by likelihood. However, the evidence never documents how stage probabilities are configured, never shows close dates driving a time-based forecast, and never names an actual revenue-forecast feature. Missing for 10: documented per-stage probability settings, close-date-based forecast by period, an explicit revenue forecasting report, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
